title: Fulfillment Available Method
description: Inventory availability hint for a fulfillment method type, with optional constraints describing what the handler needs to quote or fulfill.

type.description: Fulfillment method type this availability applies to.

line_item_ids.description: Line items available for this fulfillment method.

fulfillable_on.description: 'now' for immediate availability, or ISO 8601 date for future (preorders, transfers).

description.description: Human-readable availability info (e.g., 'Available for pickup at Downtown Store today').

required_fields.description: Top-level fulfillment-method properties that MUST be present (e.g., `destination` to require an address before this method can be quoted).

destination.description: For `shipping`: constraint on the destination postal address — what fields must be populated before the handler can return a meaningful quote (e.g., postal-code-only for fast quoting vs. full address for compliance/routing). Reuses the same `address_constraint` primitive as `card_payment_instrument` billing addresses.

constraints.description: Constraints the handler places on this fulfillment method. Follows the universal constraint shape (`constraint.json`).
